analyst.summary: KEI Industries delivered a strong FY26 (sales +20.7%, Q4 PAT +25.5%, EBITDA margin expanding to 12.21% in Q4) on a debt-free balance sheet, with the Sanand greenfield plant ramping (LT/HT commercial production started, MV/EHV due mid-FY27/Mar-27) underpinning management's 17-18% FY27 volume-growth guidance and >20% 3-4 year revenue CAGR aspiration. Set against this: trailing P/E of 51-54x and P/B of 7.07x are rich, sell-side is split (Kotak Sell on 'full' valuation vs JPMorgan/Motilal Oswal Buy), and the UltraTech/Adani (Kutch Copper) entry into wires & cables is a structural, well-funded competitive threat to industry margins that has not yet been tested through a full cycle. No material one-off item was found in Q4/FY26 results. Quant score is Hold on both horizons; fundamental view concurs -- good execution, but valuation and an unresolved competitive threat argue against adding, not against holding.
